scope: Read-only triage of /workspace/v10-preparation/v10-production-dependency-audit.json; no dependency or source changes, network/provider calls, or tests.

audit.commandEvidence: Caller reports pnpm 9 production audit exited 1.
audit.note: The audit labels all dependencies production. Static source-path review classifies development/tooling and unused transport findings separately; package flags alone are not treated as reachability proof.

baseline.result: All reviewed vulnerable package versions below were already in the baseline lockfile, except the current branch adds an explicit @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.31.0 dependency declaration to paperclip-runner. The SDK version was already present transitively through claude-agent-acp. The branch changes MCP server packages to @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.4.0, which is beyond the listed 2.x affected range.

evidence: server/src/app.ts:607-623 installs express.json globally before route/auth middleware; default inflate remains enabled; ordinary JSON limit is 10mb.
server/src/routes/projects.ts:263 validates repositoryIds before handler assertBoard; repositoryIds is an unbounded Zod array.
server/package.json uses Express 5.1; body-parser is the Express JSON parser transitive dependency.
findings.advisory_condition: Compressed request with valid frame followed by trailing bytes can emit an unhandled decoder error after parsing; auth is not needed when parser is global and runs before routing.
findings.minimal_candidate: Resolve body-parser to >=2.4.0 (prefer the smallest compatible pnpm override/lock update). This keeps compressed-body behavior and is a patch-compatible Express 5 body-parser update. Alternative inflate:false is more behavior-changing and may break clients sending compressed JSON.

findings.classification: Relevant to untrusted request validation; multiple unbounded collection schemas are reachable. High priority, but preserve major-version peer compatibility.
evidence: server/src/routes/projects.ts:263 parses an unbounded array of regex-constrained repository IDs before handler authorization.
server/src/middleware/validate.ts:5-9 synchronously parses request bodies and lets Zod construct all errors.
server/src/app.ts:607-623 allows up to 10mb JSON globally; company import has a separate 64mb JSON limit.

server/src/routes/cases-schemas.ts and server/src/routes/pipelines-schemas.ts contain records/arrays; several shared company-portability arrays have no .max() (the import path is bounded by body size, not collection count).
findings.advisory_condition: Large invalid arrays against an unconstrained array schema can accumulate validation issue objects and exhaust memory. Current branch has Zod 4.4.3 widely; audit also finds 4.1.11 and 3.25.76 under dependencies.
findings.minimal_candidate: Advance Zod 4 consumers to >=4.6.6 via compatible minor version/lock resolution; do not force Zod 4 onto the Cursor SDK's Zod 3 peer. The audit metadata reports all versions below 4.6.6 vulnerable and provides no separate patched Zod 3 range, so the Zod 3.25.76 Cursor SDK edge remains unresolved until its vendor range/backport is established. Independently add bounds to the concrete unbounded public request collections (at minimum repositoryIds) as defense in depth; a body-byte cap alone does not cap array issue count.

findings.classification: Critical audit finding but listed exploit preconditions are absent in current consumers; still recommend the one-patch update because it is a security sanitizer on untrusted input.
evidence: server/src/routes/assets.ts: sanitizeSvgBuffer sanitizes uploaded company-logo SVG with USE_PROFILES, then reparses as image/svg+xml; it does not set SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES, RETURN_DOM, RETURN_DOM_FRAGMENT, IN_PLACE, or PARSER_MEDIA_TYPE application/xhtml+xml.
server/src/services/announcement-animation.ts sanitizes a bounded untrusted HTML/CSS/SVG string to a string result; it does not enable those modes or install hooks.
findings.advisory_condition: Critical advisory requires SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES together with a DOM-returning mode and attacker DOM/shadow-root input; current calls use string output and no SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES. Other listed issues require IN_PLACE hooks or XHTML parser mode/allowlist, neither used here.
findings.minimal_candidate: Update dompurify to 3.4.17, the patched minor release, and rerun focused SVG asset/announcement sanitization tests. This is narrowly scoped and preserves current call options.
findings.priority: P2 hardening; no present critical exploit path found

findings.classification: Current application configuration does not meet the vulnerable condition.
evidence: Multer call sites in server/src/routes/assets.ts, companies.ts, issues.ts, customer-feedback.ts, and cases.ts use memoryStorage and limits; source search found no fileFilter callback.
findings.advisory_condition: Crash requires an asynchronous fileFilter still pending while request parsing is torn down. No Multer instance in the application defines fileFilter.
findings.minimal_candidate: No emergency source workaround required. Updating to >=2.5.0 is a small compatible hardening option, but lower priority than body-parser/Zod; retain the no-async-fileFilter invariant if staying on 2.4.0.

findings.classification: Credential-bearing Slack/Teams client dependency; reported array/custom-header vectors were not found in this repository's configuration.
evidence: server/src/services/chat-sdk-runtime.ts:1361-1375 builds Slack webClientOptions from retry/timeout only and passes credential config to the adapter; no header array or sensitiveHeaders option is configured.

The source tree has no direct follow-redirects or axios imports. Outbound SDK targets can be configured, but Axios supplies its normalized object-like headers; the advisories' array-form-header condition is not evidenced in the app path.
The second advisory concerns caller-declared sensitiveHeaders with regex metacharacters; no such option is supplied. Built-in Authorization/Cookie names are unaffected by that regex issue.
findings.advisory_condition: Cross-origin redirect must be followed with array-form headers for 1242604; 1242605 requires custom sensitiveHeaders with metacharacters. Neither condition is present in the Paperclip caller configuration found.
findings.minimal_candidate: Update the lock resolution to >=1.16.1 as a low-risk patch because Slack/Teams calls carry credentials and the library is on that egress path. Keep redirect/endpoint policy unchanged; do not change SDK versions.
findings.priority: P2 prudent patch, not demonstrated exploitable

findings.classification: Affected SDK code exists in dependency graph, but affected HTTP transports/server features are not used by current source paths reviewed.
evidence: rg source audit found no StreamableHTTPClientTransport, SSEClientTransport, taskStore, requireBearerAuth, verifyBearerToken, or direct @modelcontextprotocol/sdk import in packages/adapters/claude-local or paperclip-runner source.

packages/mcp-server/src/index.ts creates @modelcontextprotocol/server McpServer and packages/mcp-server/src/stdio.ts serves it over stdio only; package version is ^2.4.0, beyond the listed server affected range (<=2.2.0 for memory exhaustion/auth, <=2.3.0 for task issue).
packages/adapters/claude-local declares SDK 1.31.0; its runtime transport is Claude Agent ACP, with no application-owned MCP HTTP server/client path found.
findings.advisory_condition: Advisories require experimental taskStore on an HTTP server, MCP HTTP/SSE client transports/OAuth, unauthenticated HTTP server validation, or bearer auth without audience validation. These surfaces were not found. stdio-only use is explicitly excluded for the HTTP client/server advisories.
findings.minimal_candidate: Do not blindly upgrade ACP/Claude SDK peer stack. Retain current SDK only while the above HTTP features remain absent; add an inventory gate if an HTTP MCP transport/taskStore is introduced. The explicit direct SDK manifest addition is new relative to base but adds no found import/transport behavior.

findings.classification: No application-owned call to the affected EventSource, SRI fetch, or untrusted raw undici fetch API found.
evidence: Undici is transitive under jsdom and Discord.js/@discordjs/rest/@discordjs/ws. Source search found no direct undici import.
Current JSDOM use parses/sanitizes content and does not enable resource loading or EventSource.

Discord transport uses WebSocket/gateway and REST APIs; EventSource is not used by the application. Existing application-owned fetch calls use global fetch and several explicitly reject redirects; no direct undici override exists.
findings.advisory_condition: EventSource parser DoS requires an EventSource connection; SRI issue requires a consumer accepting mixed-case integrity tokens; excessive-content-encoding issue is on undici fetch response parsing. No direct matching caller was identified, though bundled SDK internals were not exhaustively audited.
findings.minimal_candidate: Do not force one undici version across 6.x/8.x peers based on this source-only review. If future call-site tracing shows a direct fetch/EventSource, update its compatible branch to the patched range (6.x >=6.29.1; 8.x >=8.12.2) and test that specific transport.

findings.classification: Condition absent in the current Teams adapter path inspected.
evidence: node_modules/.pnpm/@microsoft+teams.apps@2.0.16/.../dist/token-manager.js calls acquireTokenByClientCredential; no acquireTokenByCode use was found in Teams app code.
findings.advisory_condition: Advisory is specifically the authorization-code flow parameter disclosure. The inspected Teams app token manager uses client-credentials flow.
findings.minimal_candidate: No targeted app fix indicated by the current call path. Reassess if Teams OAuth authorization-code acquisition is added.

other_advisory_buckets.classification: Tooling/dev-server/mocking features, not shipped app request handling. Audit has production path artifacts through dependency trees; verify deploy package contents before treating them as runtime exposure.
UI/build-time paths; advisories require prototype-polluted renderer options or pathological selector parse input. No production server call path found.

Transitive validators/network middleware. Fast-uri versions arrive through MCP/JSON-schema dependency trees; no direct import found. ip-address is used transitively for rate-limit IP parsing; Node header bounds constrain attacker-controlled text, but exact input route deserves separate validation if proxy trust configuration permits arbitrary forwarded IP strings.

minimal_patch_order_for_owner_decision: Zod 4 workspace resolution 4.4.3/4.1.11 -> >=4.6.6, with separate decision for Cursor SDK's Zod 3.25.76 compatibility edge
follow-redirects 1.16.0 -> >=1.16.1 (compatible minor patch; credential-bearing egress dependency)
Optionally Multer 2.4.0 -> >=2.5.0; current app has no async fileFilter
limitations: Static call-path triage only; did not inspect every generated/bundled third-party source file.
No exploit reproduction, package installation, audit rerun, tests, or compatibility build was performed.
No claim that the complete dependency tree is safe or that advisories absent from the focus list are closed.

follow_up_changes.preserved: Zod 3.25.76 remains for the Cursor SDK peer; no Zod 3-to-4 override, MCP SDK/ACP upgrade, MSAL/undici upgrade, or toolchain change.

verification.result: Lockfile up to date; resolution skipped.
